last.minutes: Weighing the warning from conservative risk and the bear thesis regarding crowded positioning in PUMP, we reject adding PUMP to the spot portfolio and maintain our existing disciplined allocation in BTC, PHA, and QNT while preserving a healthy cash buffer. In the futures book, we retain our winning long position in PHA with moderate 2x leverage to capitalize on its strong momentum without overextending risk. This balanced approach protects our capital from high transaction costs and potential mean-reversion pullbacks.

futures.why: Maintaining our winning long position in PHA with moderate leverage to capture ongoing momentum.

spot.why: Foundational exposure to Bitcoin following its breakout above $85,000.
Strong momentum and quant-backed trend performance in altcoin leadership.
Consistent higher timeframe strength and high liquidity in a neutral regime.

lessons.text: Avoiding crowded speculative additions like PUMP helps preserve capital and cash buffers in neutral market regimes.

log.plan: spot: BTC 30%, PHA 25%, QNT 25%; futures: long PHA 1.5x
